description:
Chair Traverse is a 618 m less popular blue singletrack trail in Pemberton, BC. This is a multi use trail for mountain biking, e-biking, hiking, trail running & horseback riding. Dog friendly trail.

Distance 618.0 m | Ascent 12m | Descent -6m
directions: Accessed from Powerline Road or Mosquito Lake Road. Location coordinates: (50.339890, -122.755400)
title: Chair Traverse
